components.purpose: Health of the LLM wiki's pages under <wiki_folder>/queries/ (#396). Default sweep (OPT_IN False); DEFAULT_WINDOW_DAYS 9999. Reads the config file at call time from Path.home(): a missing file means the defaults; a corrupt config, an invalid wiki_folder or a queries/ folder (or subfolder) that cannot be read raises (crashed check, exit 2); a wiki that is turned off, a folder that does not exist, or an empty wiki (no indexed pages, no index.md, no index-*.md typed claude-wiki-index) reports nothing. A vault path that is not the configured vault_path (--vault or OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_VAULT; compared after expanduser and resolve) is skipped with one stderr line, because the check syncs the shared index of the configured vault. Lists the pages first, so an unreadable folder raises before the sync can drop its rows, then syncs the vault index (ensure_index on indexed_folders(strict=True)). Lists memory files at most once per scan, on the first page that cites memory, and passes the listing to every wiki.stale call. Per page: stale (any wiki.stale reason except missing:), broken-source (missing: reasons), reviewed-stale (replaces stale for reviewed pages), auto-filed (filed_by: auto), orphan (no vault note links [[page]] except the page itself and the wiki's own index.md, index-<project>.md and log-<year>.md at the wiki root; [[stem\|alias]] table links and [[stem.md]] count; only pages whose updated date is inside --days) and page-unreadable (shown even under --project). These rows are report-only: extra.unresolved, confidence 0.0, so --min-confidence above 0.0 hides every row except index-drift. Once for the wiki: index-drift (confidence 1.0) when the index files differ from wiki.render_wiki_index; apply backs up index.md and index-*.md under <backup_root>/wiki-pages/<stamp>/ and calls rebuild_wiki_index under the note_writer lock (<wiki_folder>/..wiki.ob-lock), skipped if the lock is held; an error result keeps backup_path when the backup was taken.

layers.name: Skills (prompt-based procedures)
layers.description: 19 authored SKILL.md procedures use the absolute loaded SKILL.md path to resolve OB_RESOURCE_ROOT, then call fixed brain_cli.py operations. Paired host references supply invoking-runtime conventions. No cache scan or marketplace guess selects the active installation. Missing current-client binding stops native invocation.

components.purpose: SETUP. First-run/upgrade config: vault path, folders, dashboards install, optional deps; writes the config JSON and rebuilds the index.

components.name: /vault-config
components.purpose: SETUP. Interactive numbered-menu editor for config (toggles, thresholds, snapshot flags) with atomic config rewrite.

components.purpose: CAPTURE. Saves curated session insights (multi-pick or single-topic, with update-existing path); dedups against the index via compress_guard. On a match, Step 3.5 surfaces rank+calibration, shared terms, and a note snippet so the user can adjudicate update-vs-create (#189).

components.purpose: CAPTURE. Writes ADR-lite decision notes (context/options/decision/rationale/consequences) with active/superseded status.

components.name: /error-log
components.purpose: CAPTURE. Structured error to root-cause to fix to prevention notes.

components.name: /retro
components.purpose: CAPTURE. Honest session retrospective pulling prior-session snapshots/insights as first-class evidence via gather_session_evidence. Step 3a detects a compact boundary in the active conversation (continuation preamble + cited transcript path) and recovers the prior session id to pass as also_session_ids (#184), validating each candidate against a strict id-shape regex before it reaches the vault scan. When gather_session_evidence returns prior claude-retro notes, Step 3a scopes the retrospective to the arc after the most recent one — a boundary marker, deliberately excluded from the per-snapshot coverage rule (#285).

components.name: /recall
components.purpose: RECALL. Context resume upgrades unsummarized notes through the invoking native AI backend with protected source revisions. It presents fresh or explicitly stale summary state, a context brief, and recurring themes for the project.

components.name: /vault-ask
components.purpose: RECALL. Synthesized, source-cited answer grounded in vault notes; FTS fast-path + 3 parallel Grep agents (vault_scan.py grep when the Grep tool is missing) + vault_scan.py meta for type/date ranking + per-file context-shield sub-agents + snapshot summaries. Since #395 it checks the wiki first (wiki.py lookup + stale; a fresh same-question page answers directly), caps candidates at 3 wiki pages, and ends with a filing gate: wiki.py count of 3+ qualifying notes (rejected names dropped), rewrite under wiki.py rule, then ask (user-typed) or auto-file (--caller), with reviewed pages never rewritten automatically. Payloads go through a private file, never a shell string. Since #396 it also runs a memory search on every ask that reaches Step 3 (even when the FTS fast path skips Grep; a fresh wiki answer from Step 2b stops before it): wiki.py memgrep per search term; matches join CANDIDATE_FILES as type claude-memory (+3), stay out of vault_scan.py meta, and are cited as plain text 'memory: <project-dir>/<file>.md', and count passes them as memory_sources.

components.name: /vault-search
components.purpose: RECALL. Ranked keyword/tag/structured search with snippets and snapshot markers via ensure_index + search_vault; Grep fallback, tag mode (frontmatter-only) and Step 5 metadata go through vault_scan.py.

components.purpose: RECALL. Daily/weekly cross-project standup; deep mode adds the AI item-classification + cascade-checkoff pipeline via deep_cli.

components.name: /link
components.purpose: RECALL. Bidirectional wikilink cross-referencing in Related sections (model-driven ranking, parallel Grep).

components.name: /vault-doctor
components.purpose: MAINTENANCE. Orchestrates scripts/vault_doctor.py; dry-run unless fix; documents the exit-code/crashed_checks contract and the crash-vs-apply-error remediation branch. Lists each check with its reasons, including wiki-pages (#396: only index-drift is fixed).

components.purpose: MAINTENANCE. Rebuild the FTS5 index; non-destructive by default, --full wipes the Friston tables. Rebuilds over indexed_folders(config): sessions, insights and the wiki folder (#383).

components.name: /vault-import
components.purpose: MAINTENANCE. Backfills historical sessions from the CC projects JSONLs (up to 5 parallel context-shield sub-agents).

components.name: /vault-stats
components.purpose: MAINTENANCE. Vault health + access/importance analytics; saves a trend-tracking note via compute_stats.

components.name: /dev-test
components.purpose: MAINTENANCE. Install/restore/status the explicitly selected loaded package. Scripts validate descriptors, dependency closure and selected cache metadata; failures restore prior cache/config bytes. No inferred newest-cache or current-directory source selection. Installation does not certify current frontend binding. Only install requires a verified external source. Restore uses the loaded launcher, selected native home/cache and saved backup even when the dev source is missing or unreadable.

components.name: /check-items
components.purpose: TRIAGE. Two-pass AI triage of open items: auto-checks PR-shipped items, cache-backed, cascades sibling checkoffs only for DONE groups the user actually flipped (#340). Owns partition() and classifier dispatch over the triage-pipeline modules. Step 6 (Classify) gap-fills only the group_ids classify_groups_with_agent did not cover — via classify_groups_heuristic on the residual set, not the whole payload — and stamps classifier_source ('agent'/'heuristic'/'cache') onto every verdict. Step 7 (Apply tier rules) threads classifier_source into assign_tier, reads classifier_mode off the classifications payload and prints a degradation banner whenever it is not 'ok', and marks each heuristic-derived review row with a trailing ' [heuristic]' marker. Step 10 (Persist cache) carries classifier_source through into the cache write so check_items_cache.update_cache can refuse to persist heuristic verdicts (#297); it reuses the per-project HEAD captured at Step 3 (via partition.json's heads key) rather than re-deriving it with its own git rev-parse HEAD call, so a commit landing between Step 3 and Step 10 cannot stamp a mid-run HEAD onto verdicts derived at the older one (#305). #318: Step 1 calls describe_plugin_install_divergence() (swallowing any exception) and prints a WARNING to stderr when installed obsidian-brain copies disagree on version, naming which one the hooks actually resolved to. Step 5 gathers note-completion evidence (open_item_dedup.gather_note_completion_evidence via deep_analysis_pipeline) for a repo-less project and writes the pipeline's evidence_gaps block to gaps.json. Step 8's cascade block reuses source_skips — the primary-flip loop's own record of what it actually Read-Verified-Edited — to stamp applied=True on each buckets record it corresponds to (across every classification, not just DONE) and persists the stamp back to buckets_path before Step 9 reads it. Step 9 passes merges=merge_records_from_groups(...) (never a raw count) and evidence_gaps=<the dict loaded from gaps_path>, and its classifications argument must be buckets['review'] reloaded fresh from buckets_path, not an earlier copy, so Step 8's applied stamps are not silently dropped.

components.name: /emerge
components.purpose: TRIAGE. Surfaces cross-cutting patterns over themes (not raw notes) updated in a window: run_emerge_themes builds the theme corpus, a synthesis Agent reads emerge-themes.json and writes Growing/Decaying/Cross-Project/Contradictions/New-Candidates sections, run_build_note saves the claude-emerge note. Nudges to /consolidate or a wider window when STATUS=SPARSE. Skill v2.0.0.

components.name: /consolidate
components.purpose: TRIAGE. Batch agglomerative clustering of unassigned notes into themes named by the invoking native AI backend; stats/split/merge sub-commands; --full recluster.

layers.name: Note Schema & Dashboards
layers.description: Markdown templates define every note type frontmatter and body; the universal claude/ tag prefix and type discriminator are the coupling between writers (templates) and readers (Dataview dashboards).

components.name: Note templates
components.purpose: Mustache-style templates. Curated notes (insight/decision/error-fix) carry created_at/source_session/source_session_note/project; runtime notes (session/snapshot/imported) carry session_id/git_branch/duration/status. Decision is the only curated type with a status field.

components.name: claude/ tag convention
components.purpose: Every frontmatter tag uses the claude/ prefix: type tag (claude/session, claude/insight), claude/project/<name>, claude/topic/<topic>, claude/auto, claude/imported, claude/reconstructed, claude/retro, claude/standup. Dashboards filter exclusively on these.

components.name: Dataview dashboards
components.purpose: Six Dataview/dataviewjs dashboards over claude-sessions + claude-insights: recent sessions, open items by project, decision timeline, topic/error-pattern velocity, project index, and a 7-day weekly review. Require the Obsidian Dataview plugin.

layers.name: Storage & Telemetry (datastores)
layers.description: Markdown remains the source of truth. The search index is derived. Durable coordination uses the frozen outside-vault account state root and physical vault identity. Private jobs retain native host/session/project identity; classifier cache scope crosses sessions within the same vault/provider/project.

components.name: Markdown Vault
components.purpose: The Obsidian vault (live config: a local claude-code-vault folder). Folders claude-sessions/, claude-insights/, claude-check-items/, claude-dashboards/, claude-wiki/ (#383: queries/YYYY/ pages filed by /vault-ask, plus index.md, index-<project>.md split files above 500 pages, and log-YYYY.md). The source of truth; works when Obsidian is closed.

components.name: SQLite + FTS5 index
components.purpose: The vault index DB (WAL, 0600, ~33 MB). Tables: notes, notes_fts (contentless FTS5), access_log, themes, theme_members, term_df. Derived and fully rebuildable from the vault. Coordination journals and capture cursors live outside this rebuildable index.

components.name: Config file
components.purpose: Machine-local config JSON (0600, auto-chmodded). vault_path, folder names, min_messages/min_duration thresholds, summary_model, and feature flags (auto_log_enabled, snapshot_on_compact/clear, log_raw_messages).

components.name: Secure working dir
components.purpose: Native operational artifacts use versioned private session state and explicit operation manifests. Classification verdicts use a same-vault/provider/project cross-run namespace with semantic provenance; coordination journals live separately under the frozen account state root. Explicit legacy compatibility files remain in their named adapter.

components.name: Hook telemetry log
components.purpose: Bound native SessionEnd outcomes append one key=value line to <state>/v1/<vault>/<host>/<session>/<project>/logs/obsidian-brain-hook.log (0600, rotates at 100 KB), including exception outcomes. Each session has its own log; it is not a cross-session aggregate. Unbound bootstrap failures report on stderr. The legacy Claude compatibility log remains ~/.claude/obsidian-brain-hook.log for legacy SessionEnd/SessionStart/Reaper diagnostics.

components.name: Summarizer metrics JSONL
components.purpose: Append-only summarizer metrics JSONL (0600, rotates at 100 KB). One record per upgrade_batch() run.

components.name: Durable per-vault coordination
components.purpose: Frozen coordination_root/obsidian-brain/vaults/<physical-vault-digest>/state.sqlite3 coordinates writers across native homes and index paths. The key hashes vault device and inode. The root uses absolute XDG_STATE_HOME or account .local/state, with an outside-vault /var/tmp/obsidian-brain-state-<UID> fallback. Verified legacy journals migrate under physical-vault OS ownership. Registered same-vault pending scopes retain conflicts for bounded fair recovery or explicit digest acknowledgment.

components.name: Versioned private session state
components.purpose: session_state_path(context) uses versioned vault/host/session/project identity for operational jobs, pending mutations and private artifacts. Classifier caches use vault coordination cross-run state scoped by provider and project, with full semantic provenance and separate persistent ownership; they do not include the current session key.

layers.name: Build, Release & CI
layers.description: No build step (pure Python + Markdown). Validation is the pytest suite + a layered preflight + CI. Distribution is a standalone marketplace from this repo, with plugin.json and marketplace.json version-bumped in lockstep.

components.name: bump-version.sh
components.purpose: Bumps plugin.json + marketplace.json in lockstep (major|minor|patch|X.Y.Z) with pre-bump validation, atomic marketplace write, and all-or-nothing rollback if the second write fails.

components.name: commit-preflight.sh
components.purpose: Creates a 5-minute token, tied to the current HEAD, for the require-preflight hook. A commit is allowed only while HEAD still matches (an amend: while HEAD's first parent matches). The hook keeps the token on approval only for an exactly-parsed, allowlisted command run in the project's own checkout, so a call another hook denies does not spend it; any other command spends it on approval (#408). Enforces (always-on) manifest version sync, then secret scan, then pytest with cov-fail-under 90. Flags: --docs-only, --skip-tests, --auto.

components.name: CI workflow
components.purpose: Adaptive cost-optimized CI: secret-scan, changelog-check (PRs to main), python-tests (3.12, cov>=90), python-tests-py39 (whole suite on 3.9, the macOS system python3; no coverage gate, #371), no-default-db AST guard, security-tests, and an advisory detect-release-merge check.

components.name: no-default-db.py
components.purpose: AST guard (GH #46): every ensure_index/rebuild_index/deep_analysis_pipeline call in tests/ must pass explicit db_path= so tests cannot pollute the live vault DB.

components.name: pytest suite
components.purpose: Pytest tests isolate native homes and outbound transport. Coverage remains at least 90%; collection checks actual selected-host behavior and exact reviewed launcher source hashes.

components.name: test-security.sh
components.purpose: Runs the security regression suite (path containment, secret scrub, temp-path safety) with OB_HOOKS_DIR=hooks.

components.name: Invoking-host conformance and acceptance
components.purpose: Collection requires reviewed behavior contracts and actual selected Claude/Codex contexts. Platform/Python CI runs paired contracts. Weekly isolated synthetic capture records exact source hashes and cannot prove native installed dispatch. Release acceptance requires hashed exact-commit evidence for all three clients and seven criteria; absent Desktop proof blocks acceptance. Native acceptance reads an external per-feature-SHA repository variable, validates contained hashed JSON evidence, and uploads an audit artifact. The tracked pending ledger cannot certify its own commit.

components.name: Runtime packaging and validation
components.purpose: Validates loaded roots and complete runtime packages before atomic cache publication. Codex backups and temporary packages stay outside plugins in owned, private recovery storage on the cache filesystem. Exact-byte rollback preserves permissions; legacy backups remain restorable. Version synchronization includes architecture HTML embedded metadata. Installed metadata proof does not certify current-client binding.

components.name: Runtime gates and format drift probe
components.purpose: Enforces host boundary, changed-impact, fixture privacy and runtime test contracts. Explicit local corpus probe is bounded read-only. Doctor repair state records safe administrative outcomes; no gate invents installed native acceptance.

flows.name: Explicit host context
flows.description: The shared context CLI resolves explicit identity and paths for Claude Code or Codex. Native descriptors are implemented; actual installed-client dispatch remains unverified under #272.

native host ID without another host's session scan

principles: Write-first, summarize-later: hooks always persist a raw note immediately; AI summarization is deferred to /recall.
Direct filesystem writes only — no MCP server, no REST API, no daemon; the vault works even when Obsidian is closed.
Hooks are pure stdlib, deterministic, and always exit 0; they never import the index (indexing is a skill-side concern).
Search indexing is derived and rebuildable. Durable coordination journals, capture facts and cursors are separate and survive index rebuilds.

Defense in depth on writes: path containment, atomic temp+rename, 0600/0700 perms, secret scrubbing, 1 MB stdin caps. The stdin-cap AST guard walks all three in-repo Python trees — hooks/, scripts/ and .claude/hooks/ — after #289 retired the opt-in OB_SCAN_RESOLVED_INSTALL walk over the resolved plugin-cache tree (a no-op in both configurations that occur, and upstream-dominated by this repo walk since every cache is populated from a release cut here). The five .claude/hooks/ PreToolUse gates read through a shared _read_hook_input() helper that fails CLOSED on every unusable input: a read error (non-UTF-8 or OSError), overflow past the cap, any parse failure including RecursionError, and a payload that parses but is not an object (or whose tool_input is not an object) all emit permissionDecision: deny at exit 0 — never a non-zero exit, which is a non-blocking error that lets the tool call proceed. #351 closed a class of bypasses where a global option ahead of the verb (git -C/-c/--no-pager, gh -R/--repo) skipped a gate's verb match entirely: a shared _GLOBAL_OPTS regex fragment is now spliced into each hook's verb pattern (_PUSH_VERB, _CHECKOUT_VERB, _COMMIT_VERB, _PR_CREATE_VERB, _PR_MERGE_VERB); gh -R/--repo is deliberately not descoped the way git -C is. prevent-direct-push alone splits a compound command into one invocation per push before any of that runs, and its quoted-span scanner (_quoted_spans) is what decides whether a given ;/&/| is a real separator or sits inside a closed quoted run; a bisect over the sorted span offsets keeps that split linear rather than quadratic in separators x spans. It additionally denies --mirror/--prune/--all/--branches outright (_all_ref_flags, prefix-matched against git's own abbreviation rules) and any refspec whose destination glob could match a protected ref (_branch_glob_refspecs, via fnmatch), decides a protected push or delete target on ref tokens anywhere in the argument list rather than adjacency to the remote (_protected_push_refs/_protected_delete_refs), and anchors its tag allowlist to a single ref token below the deletion gates (_is_tag_ref/_VERSION_TAG) instead of three unanchored substring tests that used to run ahead of it. Known gaps, all pre-existing and not regressions: three quoted spellings of a global-option token remain fail-open (pinned as strict xfail rows so a future fix can't pass silently), and those rows sample a wider class rather than bounding it - the executable and verb words themselves can be quoted or escaped (git "push", git p'u'sh, "git" push) and are not normalised, so a mangled verb skips the entry test on all five gates; a #-comment, an unbalanced quote inside one, a case ... ) pattern, or a heredoc body ahead of a git -C are blind spots in the shared _shell_scan scoping helper and now cost a fail-closed false deny on legitimate cross-repo -C work; and a mirror configured via remote.<name>.mirror rather than the --mirror flag is invisible to command text.
Native AI uses only the invoking host. Requested model aliases and observed actual model IDs are separate; unknown identity cannot authorize cache replay.
constraints: Python stdlib only — no pip dependencies (hooks run at session boundaries where install state is unknown).
All hooks must exit 0 regardless of outcome (a non-zero hook would disrupt the host session).
Vault writes enter the revision-checked transaction boundary. Atomic replacement publishes note bytes; moves and deletes use separate no-clobber, journaled protocols.
User-data files are 0600, working dirs 0700; no predictable /tmp paths.
Test coverage gate: cov-fail-under 90 on hooks; tests must pass explicit db_path= (no live-DB pollution).
Dashboards require the Obsidian Dataview community plugin (JavaScript + inline queries).

tradeoffs.decision: Defer Claude CLI summarization from SessionEnd to /recall (write-first).
alternatives: Summarize synchronously in the SessionEnd hook
Background daemon to summarize
tradeoffs.rationale: A SessionEnd subprocess is SIGKILLed when the session process-tree exits, so synchronous summarization is unreliable. Writing the raw note first guarantees no session is ever lost; /recall upgrades on demand.

tradeoffs.decision: DELETE-then-INSERT in the index instead of INSERT OR REPLACE.
alternatives: INSERT OR REPLACE
UPSERT via ON CONFLICT for the whole row
tradeoffs.rationale: REPLACE would drop the learned importance value and orphan rows in the contentless FTS5 table. Explicit delete+insert preserves importance and issues the FTS delete op with old values so the index never accumulates orphans.

tradeoffs.decision: Friston-preserving non-destructive rebuild as the default.
alternatives: Always full wipe + rebuild
tradeoffs.rationale: access_log activation, theme centroids and Free-Energy surprise are expensive learned signals with no source of truth outside the DB. A blind wipe would discard them; full=True is reserved for corrupt/incompatible schema.

tradeoffs.decision: canonical_project_name() collapses worktrees via the git common-dir.
alternatives: Use the cwd basename verbatim
tradeoffs.rationale: Worktrees have distinct cwd basenames but are one logical project; collapsing them keeps a feature branch notes grouped with the main repo and prevents fragmented project scopes.

tradeoffs.decision: Snapshot-anchor bypass: log below-threshold sessions if they have sibling snapshots.
alternatives: Apply message/duration thresholds uniformly
tradeoffs.rationale: A short session that nonetheless produced a PreCompact snapshot needs a parent note to anchor that snapshot backlink; dropping it would orphan real captured context.

tradeoffs.decision: vault-doctor apply() raises on any non-canonical signal_class.
alternatives: Apply whatever scan() returned
tradeoffs.rationale: Makes the --min-confidence filter override-safe: a low-confidence WARN can never be force-applied, because apply() refuses to act on anything but the one resolvable signal_class it was designed to fix.

tradeoffs.decision: Escalate exit code to 2 when a check crashes, even at 0 issues.
alternatives: Return 0 on a crashed-but-no-issues run
tradeoffs.rationale: Automation must not read an incomplete sweep as a clean bill of health; a crash means coverage was partial, so the run is flagged distinctly from a genuine all-clear.

tradeoffs.decision: L2 deterministic prefilter with a distinctiveness gate before the LLM classifier.
alternatives: Send every open item to the classifier
tradeoffs.rationale: Most open items have no plausible completion evidence and can be triaged for free; the distinctiveness gate (snake_case / len>=8 / interior mixed-case) stops generic short words like add/fix from accidentally matching unrelated shipped features.

tradeoffs.decision: Classifier chunking at <=25 groups per invoking native call.
alternatives: One sub-agent call for the whole payload
Raise the timeout ceiling
tradeoffs.rationale: Bounded chunks retain verified covered verdicts after ordinary chunk failures. Missing groups remain visible and cannot be approved or cached as a complete result.

tradeoffs.decision: Native capture uses durable operation identity and OS ownership.
alternatives: Publish duplicate capture from multiple installations
Treat lock age as permission to take over a live holder
tradeoffs.rationale: An unavailable owner leaves facts pending. Verified replay acknowledges the same operation once and preserves manual note edits.

tradeoffs.decision: Resolve runtime resources from the loaded SKILL.md or explicit validated package root.
alternatives: Infer the active plugin from the newest cache directory
Use unrelated current-directory or marketplace paths
tradeoffs.rationale: The loaded package supplies the real runtime. Scripts validate explicit roots and descriptors; reviewed drift tests reject unrelated or incomplete trees. Installer metadata proves selected cache paths without claiming current frontend binding.

tradeoffs.decision: Keep durable per-vault coordination separate from the search index and private caches.
alternatives: Put cursors in the rebuildable index
Treat successful rename as cursor acknowledgment
tradeoffs.rationale: An index rebuild must not erase replay state. A crash between note replacement and cursor commit must recover using immutable operation/checkpoint evidence, preserving manual edits.

tradeoffs.decision: Use persistent OS ownership and drop unowned cache updates.
